calendar.fit_permission: no fitted coefficient; all thresholds frozen
calendar.window_assignment: UTC half-open windows with entry and scheduled exit contained

causal_availability.already_aligned_rule: an aligned available_at still receives the additional 300s bar
causal_availability.source_available_at: max header timestamp from packet start through h+6 + 48 hours
causal_availability.source_gap_action: reject source; never fill or backdate

controls.constant_long_same_clock: same primary entry/exit clock with side fixed long
controls.constant_short_same_clock: same primary entry/exit clock with side fixed short
controls.direction_flip: same primary entry/exit clock and eligibility with every side multiplied by -1; diagnostic only
controls.endpoint_only: require nonzero endpoint_transport and endpoint_magnitude_rank>=0.75; side=sign(endpoint_transport); build an independent chronological non-overlap clock
controls.fee_only: require nonzero fee_transport and fee_magnitude_rank>=0.75; side=-sign(fee_transport); build an independent chronological non-overlap clock
controls.month_side_stratified_random_clock: within each split-month SHA256-order rank-ready split-contained candidates by 20260720|window|month|entry_time; take the primary month total and preserve the primary long/short counts
controls.one_bar_delayed_entry: same primary signals and sides; shift entry and scheduled exit exactly one complete 5m bar later; deterministically drop a shifted trade that loses its original split containment, never replace it, and report train/selection dropped counts before outcomes
controls.same_direction: require fee_transport*endpoint_transport>0 and strain_rank>=0.75; side=sign(endpoint_transport); build an independent chronological non-overlap clock
controls.stale_14_packets: at source packet t apply primary eligibility and side from the fully formed feature/ranks at t-14; retain t availability and build an independent chronological non-overlap clock

eligibility.ordering: sort by entry_time then packet_id; accept earliest when entry_time>=prior accepted exit; equal boundary allowed; suppress intervening candidates without score priority or replacement
eligibility.zero_tolerance: none; exact zero in either transport is ineligible

execution.funding: exact funding, entry-inclusive/exit-exclusive, fixed entry quantity

normalization.window_selection: use exactly the most recent 180 strict-prior base-valid rows when available; fewer than 120 makes current rank-unready

policy.promotion_boundary: pre-2024 pass required before a separately frozen 2024-2026 source extension; no live promotion before field parity and 90 forward shadow days

source_features.base_valid_feature_row: require t-2,t-1,t as consecutive valid 72-block packets; each packet has exactly 72 contiguous heights and positive finite total_weight, total_fees, and total_endpoints; all derived values finite
source_features.edge_packet_policy: drop incomplete first and last packets
source_features.numeric_contract: IEEE-754 binary64 and natural log; no epsilon, clipping, rounding, interpolation, forward fill, reassignment, or imputation; exact binary64 equality defines zero and ties

policy.stopping_rule: stop permanently at first support/train/selection failure; no sign, threshold, rank-window, packet, support-floor, hold, latency, calendar, or clock repair; no failed-policy inversion

strict_accounting.cagr_clock: full declared wall-clock window including idle cash
strict_accounting.cluster_test: one-sided weekly entry-cluster sign flip; 100000 draws; seed 20260720
strict_accounting.costs: entry, scheduled exit, and hypothetical adverse liquidation costs included
strict_accounting.held_path_order: all favorable OHLC/funding-credit extremes before all adverse OHLC/funding-debit extremes

support_gates.count_basis: accepted primary entries after eligibility, split containment, and chronological non-overlap
support_gates.delayed_entry_split_edge_reporting: report train and selection dropped counts before outcomes; dropped trades receive no replacement
support_gates.support_failure_action: reject FETD-288 before market/funding/outcomes; no repair

research_sequence.outcomes: train first; selection only after exact train pass

source_manifest.data_use: private internal research cache of consensus-derived fields via public Mempool REST transport; the API output has no separately documented data licence, production must use an owned Bitcoin Core node, and no raw response or unrelated metadata is redistributed
